failure_audit.purpose: Saved-state diagnosis of collection failures; not policy evaluation.

representative_contact_snapshot.method: Contact recomputed at the saved pose; rounded to 0.001 mm. This is a sampled self-contact, not a physics-rate maximum.

failure_audit.quality_metric_limitation: The existing quality_pass checks target-cube penetration and distractor displacement, not all robot self-contacts.
failure_audit.dataset_decision: Keep all 18 candidates and all six failures; do not train this incomplete pickup-slot distribution.

preflight.reason: Development preflight before adding the 12 mm command bound and coverage check.
